prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-29
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 93f454ae1b45eb9a
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback UART sent 0xa5 but recv_buf_data latched 0xd2, causing TRAP uart data mismatch and tohost FAIL 0xdead. Root cause is duplicate case label 0 in recv_state case: the half-bit start-center wait (2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) is labeled 0 instead of 1 so state 1 is dead and falls to default full-bit wait. This half-bit sampling offset corrupts received bits.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 93f454ae1b45eb9a in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
